title: wool_carpets
description: Used to check whether or not an item can go in the decoration slot of a llama, but items other than carpets do not change the llama visually.
Used to check if an item can go in the fuel slot of a furnace and to return a burn time of 67.
Used in the dampens_vibrations item tag.

title: chest_boats
description: Used in the boats item tag.

title: cluster_max_harvestables
description: When amethyst clusters are broken with an item in this tag, they drop 4 amethyst shards.

title: fox_food
description: Foxes treat items in this tag like they do sweet berries.

title: freeze_immune_wearables
description: Entities with an item in this tag in any armor slot do not freeze.

title: piglin_food
description: Piglins can "eat" items in this tag.
Eating refers to the piglin seeking out and picking up an item without appearing in its inventory, thus vanishing.

title: ignored_by_piglin_babies
description: Baby piglins do not attempt to pick up items in this tag. Baby piglins still follow the other rules adult piglins follow.
Takes precedence over piglin_food, and piglin_loved item tags when an item is in both.

title: candles
description: Cakes use this tag to determine if a candle item can be placed on it or not.
Adding items to this tag has no effect.

title: piglin_loved
description: Piglins actively seek out items in this tag.
Piglins view players holding items in this tag as holding a "loved" item.
Used in the distract_piglin.json advancement file.

title: creeper_drop_music_discs
description: Used to determine what a creeper drops when killed by a skeleton.
Used in the entities/creeper.json loot table.
Used in the music_discs item tag.

title: stone_tool_materials
description: Used in the mine_stone.json, stone_axe.json, stone_hoe.json, stone_pickaxe.json, stone_shovel.json and stone_sword.json advancement and recipe files.
Items in this tag can be used to repair stone tools in an anvil.

title: non_flammable_wood
description: Items in this tag cannot be used as fuel in a furnace.
If items are removed from this tag, they can be used as fuel only if they are part of a tag that can be used as fuel.

title: piglin_repellents
description: Piglins do not attempt to pick up items in this tag.

title: gold_ores
description: Used in the gold_ingot.json and gold_ingot_from_blasting.json advancement and recipe files.
Used in the <code>piglin_loved<code> item tag.

title: beacon_payment_items
description: Used by beacons to check which items can be placed inside of its GUI to select an effect.

title: crimson_stems
description: Used in the crimson_planks.json advancement and recipe files.

title: lectern_books
description: Controls what items can be put on a lectern. Items cannot be added to this tag, only removed.

title: arrows
description: Controls what items can be shot by bows and crossbows.
Any items added to the tag can be shot and picked up as a normal arrow.
It is good to note that the Bedrock has the arrow tag but it only contains the minecraft:arrow item.

title: wooden_fences
description: Used in the fences item tag.

title: small_flowers
description: Used in the suspicious stew recipe. Adding items does not allow them to be used in suspicious stew, but removing them disallows them from being used.
Items in this tag that give suspicious stew an effect can be fed to brown mooshrooms.
Used in the flowers item tag.
